research_scope: Source-free independent Wave2 full-context prerequisite review of two mathematically exact identities; no population/source edits, no external research, no certification or consolidation.

aliases.reason: The affine-scheme and locally affine scheme formulations explicitly say 'isomorphic as a locally ringed space', meaning a morphism of locally ringed spaces with two-sided inverse in that category, respecting the continuous map, structure sheaves and local stalk maps. The existing generic categorical-isomorphism candidate requires f:X→Y and g:Y→X with gf=id_X and fg=id_Y, with no underlying-set bijection alone assumed. Instantiating its ambient category to locally ringed spaces gives exactly the same underlying invertibility prerequisite. This does NOT identify an arbitrary bijection or underlying topological homeomorphism with a locally ringed-space isomorphism; the category/morphism type stays explicit in the affine/scheme parent statements.

The interval-weight formulation defines orthogonality of distinct-degree p_n,p_m by ∫p_n(x)p_m(x)w(x)dx=0 for n≠m, with nonnegative integrable weight and finite absolute moments. The measure formulation defines the same mixed-inner-product vanishing ∫p_n(x)p_m(x)dμ(x)=0 for n≠m for a nonnegative measure μ. On the stated interval, define μ_w(B)=∫_{B∩(a,b)} w(x)dx; then dμ_w=w(x)dx and the two displayed orthogonality prerequisites coincide exactly. In the measure source μ may be more general (including singular Lebesgue–Stieltjes parts), so the measure-level prerequisite is the valid common abstraction; weights, density/absolute continuity, support, admissibility and moments remain distinctly specified in the full parent formulations. No claim that arbitrary μ must possess density w.
